short_description: LAIA optical imager filters on the Telescopio Joan Oro (TJO)

licence.scope: Site-wide legal notice of the Institut d'Estudis Espacials de Catalunya (IEEC), operator of the Telescopi Joan Oró and LAIA (level 3: the page SVO cites, https://www.ieec.cat/content/18/laia/, carries no terms). It covers the IEEC website and its contents and requires prior written consent for exploitation beyond the Intellectual Property Law; it does not name the filter curves. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
